Method of Attack: Information-stealer and keylogger that steals credentials stored in web browsers, email clients, FTP, and other software
Infects targets via malicious phishing emails carrying malicious attachments (e.g., PowerPoint documents)
Used to steal account credentials, access email communications, and perform surveillance to prepare for BEC attacks
Impacted Systems: Corporate organizations and oil & gas firms in the Middle East, North Africa, and Southeast Asia
Indicators of Compromise: Laptops and mobile phones of arrested individuals showing signs of Agent Tesla deployment
